key: Whew! I've been working all day helping out some of the repairmen under the city!
en: Whew! I've been working all day helping out some of the repairmen under the city!
ja: ふう!一日中、街の地下で修理業者の手伝いをしてたんだ!

key: We're setting up for the Railnet to be restored! I can't wait to not have to walk to work every morning!
en: We're setting up for the Railnet to be restored! I can't wait to not have to walk to work every morning!
ja: 地下鉄道網の復旧に向けて準備してるんだよ!毎朝歩いて仕事に行かなくてよくなるのが待ちきれないね!

key: Is it coincidence that just after the Gates open, this city began to restore itself?
en: Is it coincidence that just after the Gates open, this city began to restore itself?
ja: ゲートが開いた直後にこの街が自ら復興し始めたのは、偶然なんだろうか?

key: Energy must not be allowed to stagnate. If you stay in motion, you will be well.
en: Energy must not be allowed to stagnate. If you stay in motion, you will be well.
ja: エネルギーを停滞させてはならない。動き続けていれば、うまくいく。

key: LIN: okay, i can't go in there.
en: LIN: okay, i can't go in there.
ja: リン: だめ、あそこには入れない。

key: if i go in there, they will literally kill me.
en: if i go in there, they will literally kill me.
ja: もし入ったら、本当に殺される。

key: and frankly, same!
en: and frankly, same!
ja: つーか、殺されて当然だし!

key: i don't understand why i'm not dead already!
en: i don't understand why i'm not dead already!
ja: なんでまだ生きてるのか自分でもわからない!

key: what are we doing here
en: what are we doing here
ja: なんでこんなとこにいるんだろう

key: help
en: help
ja: たすけて

key: i literally terrorized this region and now i'm just walking around and nothing is happening?????
en: i literally terrorized this region and now i'm just walking around and nothing is happening?????
ja: この地方をまじで恐怖に陥れといて、今はただ歩き回ってるだけで何も起きないとか?????

key: hellooooo, wanted war criminal here????
en: hellooooo, wanted war criminal here????
ja: もしもーし、指名手配の戦犯がここにいますけどぉ????

key: LIN: it was a lot easier to interact with your friends when i was literally god.
en: LIN: it was a lot easier to interact with your friends when i was literally god.
ja: リン: あんたの友達と関わるのは、あたしが本物の神様だった頃の方がずっと楽だったな。

key: maybe i shouldn't say that too loud.
en: maybe i shouldn't say that too loud.
ja: まああんまり大声で言うことじゃないか。

key: let's not look a gift horsea in the mouth.
en: let's not look a gift horsea in the mouth.
ja: もらったタッツーの口の中はのぞかないでおこう。

key: LIN: oh, great, you're awake.
en: LIN: oh, great, you're awake.
ja: リン: おっ、よかった、目が覚めたんだ。

key: i guess that's to be expected.
en: i guess that's to be expected.
ja: まあ、当然っちゃ当然か。

key: ANNA: ...Lin?
en: ANNA: ...Lin?
ja: アンナ: ……リン?

key: I almost didn't recognize you without the puddle!
en: I almost didn't recognize you without the puddle!
ja: あの水たまりがないと、あたし危うく気づかないところだったよ!

key: LIN: the what.
en: LIN: the what.
ja: リン: は?何が。

key: ANNA: You know, the puddle!
en: ANNA: You know, the puddle!
ja: アンナ: だから、水たまりだよ!

key: The eternal puddle of gloom that occludes your every waking moment!
en: The eternal puddle of gloom that occludes your every waking moment!
ja: あんたが起きてる間ずっとまとわりついてる、永遠の陰気な水たまり!

key: LIN: anna what the fuck are you saying
en: LIN: anna what the fuck are you saying
ja: リン: アンナ、あんた何言ってんのマジで

key: ANNA: Oh, nevermind!
en: ANNA: Oh, nevermind!
ja: アンナ: あ、なんでもない!

key: Do you want to come in and meet everyone?
en: Do you want to come in and meet everyone?
ja: 中に入ってみんなに会ってみない?

key: LIN: no?
en: LIN: no?
ja: リン: いや?

key: ANNA: Okay, but do it anyway!
en: ANNA: Okay, but do it anyway!
ja: アンナ: オッケー、でもとにかくやるよ!

key: You're done trying to end the world, right?
en: You're done trying to end the world, right?
ja: 世界を終わらせようとするのはもうやめたんでしょ?

key: Putting yourself out there and meeting people for real is the first step on the path to showing everyone that you're trying to live a normal and better life!
en: Putting yourself out there and meeting people for real is the first step on the path to showing everyone that you're trying to live a normal and better life!
ja: 自分から人前に出て本当にみんなと会うことが、あんたが普通でよりよい人生を送ろうとしてるって証明する第一歩になるんだよ!

key: LIN: ...
en: LIN: ...
ja: リン: ……

key: ANNA: I know we had our differences before, but following \PN's example, everything that happened just shows we need to set those aside!
en: ANNA: I know we had our differences before, but following \PN's example, everything that happened just shows we need to set those aside!
ja: アンナ: 前は色々あったけど、\PNのおかげで、あの出来事は全部、あたしたちがそういうのを脇に置くべきだって示してるだけだから!

key: Come on, come on-- Let's go!
en: Come on, come on-- Let's go!
ja: ほら、ほら――行くよ!

key: LIN: okay, well, they are YOUR friends, so...
en: LIN: okay, well, they are YOUR friends, so...
ja: リン: はいはい、まああんたの友達なんだし……

key: hopefully they don't kill me
en: hopefully they don't kill me
ja: 殺されなきゃいいけど

key: because that would suck.
en: because that would suck.
ja: 殺されたらマジで最悪だし。

key: Welcome to the Reborn Nightclub! --ACE MEMBERS ONLY--
en: Welcome to the Reborn Nightclub! --ACE MEMBERS ONLY--
ja: リボーンナイトクラブへようこそ!――エースメンバー限定――

key: Gotta hustle!
en: Gotta hustle!
ja: 気合入れて働かなきゃ!

key: If the city's gettin' in shape, I should too!
en: If the city's gettin' in shape, I should too!
ja: 街が体を鍛え直してるなら、あたしもそうしなきゃ!

key: In order to stop people from getting lost or hurt in the caverns below, city ordinance has mandated restricted access to the area.
en: In order to stop people from getting lost or hurt in the caverns below, city ordinance has mandated restricted access to the area.
ja: 地下の洞窟で人々が迷ったり怪我をしたりするのを防ぐため、市の条例によりこの区域への立ち入りは制限されています。

key: As such, all general civilians are asked to turn back.
en: As such, all general civilians are asked to turn back.
ja: そのため、一般市民の方には引き返していただくようお願いしております。

key: You, however, may go right ahead.
en: You, however, may go right ahead.
ja: ただし、あなたはそのまま進んでいただいて構いません。

key: Take care if you go down there.
en: Take care if you go down there.
ja: 下に行くなら気をつけてください。

key: Have a good day.
en: Have a good day.
ja: それでは、よい一日を。

key: I hear Sweet Co.'s hiring. They really are on the up and up here, huh?
en: I hear Sweet Co.'s hiring. They really are on the up and up here, huh?
ja: スイート社が人を募集してるらしいよ。ここでは本当に順調にやってるんだな。

key: Maybe I should apply.
en: Maybe I should apply.
ja: 応募してみようかな。

key: Hail, Trainer.
en: Hail, Trainer.
ja: よう、トレーナー。

key: City watch is on the look-out for trouble. If you see anything suspicious, please report it to us.
en: City watch is on the look-out for trouble. If you see anything suspicious, please report it to us.
ja: 自警団はトラブルに目を光らせています。不審なものを見かけたら、私たちに知らせてください。

key: Hey, did you hear?
en: Hey, did you hear?
ja: ねえ、聞いた?

key: This place is super exclusive, so most people can't get inside, but I heard they were hiring...
en: This place is super exclusive, so most people can't get inside, but I heard they were hiring...
ja: ここってすごい会員制で、ほとんどの人は入れないんだけど、募集してるって聞いて……

key: I wanted to get in one way or another, so I grabbed a bunch of applications and ran!
en: I wanted to get in one way or another, so I grabbed a bunch of applications and ran!
ja: どうにかして入りたかったから、応募用紙を山ほどつかんで走ってきたの!

key: I was already rejected, but now I have all of these left over.
en: I was already rejected, but now I have all of these left over.
ja: もう落とされちゃったんだけど、これだけ余っちゃって。

key: Here, take one! Why not?!
en: Here, take one! Why not?!
ja: はい、一枚どうぞ!別にいいでしょ!?

key: You were looking for me? I don't think we've met.
en: You were looking for me? I don't think we've met.
ja: おれを探してたのか?会ったことはないと思うけど。

key: DJ Arclight, at your service. Arc's fine for short though.
en: DJ Arclight, at your service. Arc's fine for short though.
ja: DJアークライト、よろしくな。短くアークでいいぜ。

key: Remember the name.
en: Remember the name.
ja: この名前、覚えとけよ。

key: So, Ame sent you?
en: So, Ame sent you?
ja: で、アメがお前をよこしたのか?

key: ARC: Yo, \PN! How you doing?
en: ARC: Yo, \PN! How you doing?
ja: アーク: よう、\PN!調子はどうだ?

key: ARC: Yo. \PN, right?
en: ARC: Yo. \PN, right?
ja: アーク: よう。\PNだよな?

key: Ame sent you to get me?
en: Ame sent you to get me?
ja: アメがお前をおれを呼びによこしたのか?

key: You're really running all over the place since getting back, huh?
en: You're really running all over the place since getting back, huh?
ja: 戻ってきてから、本当にあちこち走り回ってるんだな?

key: Right. I think I've got a pretty good idea of what this is about.
en: Right. I think I've got a pretty good idea of what this is about.
ja: そうか。だいたい何の話かは見当がついてるぜ。

key: I ended up getting pretty involved in the city's business after Adrienn asked me to throw a tag out for xem on the broadcasts.
en: I ended up getting pretty involved in the city's business after Adrienn asked me to throw a tag out for xem on the broadcasts.
ja: アドリエンヌに放送で宣伝してくれって頼まれてから、街の仕事にすっかり関わることになっちまってな。

key: We were able to recruit a lot of volunteers that way... though some of them just wanted to meet me.
en: We were able to recruit a lot of volunteers that way...  though some of them just wanted to meet me.
ja: おかげでボランティアを大勢集められた……まあ中にはおれに会いたいだけのやつもいたけどな。

key: That was a mess...
en: That was a mess...
ja: あれはひどい騒ぎだったよ……

key: Uh, anyway, I recently got a call-in tip from a listener about--
en: Uh, anyway, I recently got a call-in tip from a listener about--
ja: ああ、とにかく、最近リスナーから電話でタレコミがあってな――

key: Well, it seems like it's Team Meteor again.
en: Well, it seems like it's Team Meteor again.
ja: どうやら、またチームメテオみたいだぜ。

key: Big shock, I know.
en: Big shock, I know.
ja: 驚くことでもないけどな。

key: All right, I'll go on ahead. Gotta clear out the area first.
en: All right, I'll go on ahead. Gotta clear out the area first.
ja: よし、おれは先に行くぜ。まずは辺りを片づけないとな。

key: Tell Ame that I'll be waiting at the meeting place.
en: Tell Ame that I'll be waiting at the meeting place.
ja: アメには、集合場所で待ってるって伝えといてくれ。

key: ARC: \PN! I'm comin' with you on this one.
en: ARC: \PN! I'm comin' with you on this one.
ja: アーク: \PN!今回はおれも一緒に行くぜ。

key: It's a little hard to get details out of that Smeargle, but from what I've gathered, we ain't gonna be alone out there.
en: It's a little hard to get details out of that Smeargle, but from what I've gathered, we ain't gonna be alone out there.
ja: あのドーブルから詳しい話を聞き出すのは少し大変だったが、集めた情報からすると、現地でおれたちだけってわけじゃなさそうだ。

key: There've been some other reports coming in since all this Legendary business went dissonant.
en: There've been some other reports coming in since all this Legendary business went dissonant.
ja: この伝説ポケモン絡みの騒ぎがおかしくなり始めてから、他にも通報が入ってきてる。

key: You and I, and the leaders-- we hunt them to keep others safe.
en: You and I, and the leaders-- we hunt them to keep others safe.
ja: お前とおれ、それにジムリーダーたちは――みんなを守るために追ってるんだ。

key: Others hunt them for more problematic pursuits-- profit, power, and personal gain.
en: Others hunt them for more problematic pursuits-- profit, power, and personal gain.
ja: だが他の連中は、もっとやっかいな目的で追ってる――金、権力、自分の得のためにな。

key: You already know I ain't about that.
en: You already know I ain't about that.
ja: おれがそんなのに興味ないってことは、お前ももう知ってるだろ。

key: Had enough of cages, between Devon and 7th Street alike.
en: Had enough of cages, between Devon and 7th Street alike.
ja: デボンでも7番街でも、おりってやつにはもうたくさんだ。

key: We can't stop folks from making a living, but we can't let 'em do it like this either.
en: We can't stop folks from making a living, but we can't let 'em do it like this either.
ja: 生活のためにやってる連中を止めることはできない。だが、こんなやり方でやらせておくわけにもいかない。

key: I'm heading straight over there-- That old Railcave in Chrysolia, I've figured.
en: I'm heading straight over there-- That old Railcave in Chrysolia, I've figured.
ja: おれはまっすぐそこへ向かう――クリソリアのあの古い廃線どうくつだと踏んでる。

key: The poachers said something about following the rocks inside.
en: The poachers said something about following the rocks inside.
ja: 密猟者たちが、中の岩に沿って進むとか何とか言ってたんだ。

key: See you on that side.
en: See you on that side.
ja: 向こうで会おうぜ。

key: Gosh, I kinda miss the lazy days of our old city.
en: Gosh, I kinda miss the lazy days of our old city.
ja: ああ、昔ののんびりした街が懐かしいなあ。

key: Now everyone's all 'business that' and 'community this'.
en: Now everyone's all 'business that' and 'community this'.
ja: 今じゃみんな「ビジネスがどう」「コミュニティがどう」ばっかりだもの。

key: Bonjour, my beautiful friend.
en: Bonjour, my beautiful friend.
ja: ボンジュール、美しき我が友よ。

key: I have heard rumours that you have been behind many of the city's strides, non?
en: I have heard rumours that you have been behind many of the city's strides, non?
ja: この街の発展の裏には君がいるとうわさで聞いたのだが、そうだろう?

key: We thank you for your service.
en: We thank you for your service.
ja: 君の働きに感謝するよ。

key: It seems I was right to invest in Sweet Co.
en: It seems I was right to invest in Sweet Co.
ja: どうやらスイート社に投資したのは正解だったようだ。

key: Now what other companies are going to be up and coming?
en: Now what other companies are going to be up and coming?
ja: さて、次に伸びる企業はどこかな?

key: Transportation, maybe?
en: Transportation, maybe?
ja: 運輸業とかどうだろう?

key: I'm on a roll!
en: I'm on a roll!
ja: 絶好調だよ!

key: I knew putting stock into the resurging Railnet was the right thing to do!
en: I knew putting stock into the resurging Railnet was the right thing to do!
ja: 復活しつつある地下鉄道網に投資したのは正しい判断だったんだ!

key: Soon, I shall be the economic centrepiece of Reborn!
en: Soon, I shall be the economic centrepiece of Reborn!
ja: すぐにでも、私がリボーンの経済の中心になるだろう!

key: ADRIENN: Okay,
en: ADRIENN: Okay,
ja: アドリエンヌ: では、

key: First question: Why?
en: First question: Why?
ja: 最初の質問。なぜですか?

key: Second question: How?
en: Second question: How?
ja: 二つ目の質問。どうやって?

key: I thought we were at the top of Devon Corp., not here.
en: I thought we were at the top of Devon Corp., not here.
ja: 私たちはデボンコーポのトップにいるはずで、ここにいるはずではなかったのですが。

key: VICTORIA: Adrienn, when you were with Ame, what exactly happened?
en: VICTORIA: Adrienn, when you were with Ame, what exactly happened?
ja: ヴィクトリア: アドリエンヌ、アメと一緒にいた時、一体何があったんですか?

key: ADRIENN: When Arclight activated the signal, we entered through the front as planned.
en: ADRIENN: When Arclight activated the signal, we entered through the front as planned.
ja: アドリエンヌ: アークライトが信号を発動させた時、私たちは予定通り正面から入りました。

key: There was the expected resistance, but then as soon as we finished dealing with them,
en: There was the expected resistance, but then as soon as we finished dealing with them,
ja: 予想していた抵抗はありましたが、それを片づけ終えた途端、

key: The exits sealed.
en: The exits sealed.
ja: 出口が封鎖されました。

key: It was some kind of gas trap.
en: It was some kind of gas trap.
ja: 何らかのガストラップだったのです。

key: I don't remember what happened after that.
en: I don't remember what happened after that.
ja: それから後のことは覚えていません。

key: VICTORIA: When I was trying to keep a path clear for \PN, another group of Meteors came from out of nowhere and knocked me out.
en: VICTORIA: When I was trying to keep a path clear for \PN, another group of Meteors came from out of nowhere and knocked me out.
ja: ヴィクトリア: \PNのために道を確保しようとしていた時、どこからともなくメテオの別の一団が現れて、私を気絶させたんです。

key: ADRIENN: So it seems likely that after rendering each of us unconscious, they transported us to this building.
en: ADRIENN: So it seems likely that after rendering each of us unconscious, they transported us to this building.
ja: アドリエンヌ: つまり、私たち全員を気絶させたあと、この建物まで運んだ可能性が高いということですね。

key: VICTORIA: And again, I was too weak to stop it.
en: VICTORIA: And again, I was too weak to stop it.
ja: ヴィクトリア: それに、私は弱すぎて止められませんでした。

key: Now that I think about it,
en: Now that I think about it,
ja: 考えてみれば、

key: Kiki was also weak.
en: Kiki was also weak.
ja: キキも弱かった。

key: Her body was killing itself.
en: Her body was killing itself.
ja: 彼女の体は、自らをむしばんでいました。

key: She couldn't stop that,
en: She couldn't stop that,
ja: それを止めることはできなかった。

key: And I'm not sure she ever truly accepted it.
en: And I'm not sure she ever truly accepted it.
ja: そして、彼女が本当にそれを受け入れていたのかも、私にはわかりません。

key: I think I understand how the student becomes the master now.
en: I think I understand how the student becomes the master now.
ja: 弟子がどうやって師を超えるのか、今ならわかる気がします。

key: We've got a lot of work to do.
en: We've got a lot of work to do.
ja: やるべきことはたくさんありますね。

key: ADRIENN: As always!
en: ADRIENN: As always!
ja: アドリエンヌ: いつものことです!

key: VICTORIA: But despite all of us being so pitifully weak,
en: VICTORIA: But despite all of us being so pitifully weak,
ja: ヴィクトリア: でも、私たちがみんなこんなに情けないほど弱かったのに、

key: Look how far we've come.
en: Look how far we've come.
ja: ここまで来られたんですよね。

key: ADRIENN: Yeah.
en: ADRIENN: Yeah.
ja: アドリエンヌ: ええ。

key: Let's protect this city.
en: Let's protect this city.
ja: この街を守りましょう。

key: So this building was a cover for a Meteor facility too.
en: So this building was a cover for a Meteor facility too.
ja: つまりこの建物も、メテオの施設を隠すための表向きだったわけですね。

key: That's a lead.
en: That's a lead.
ja: 手がかりになりますね。

key: Whoever was responsible for this probably has ties to Team Meteor.
en: Whoever was responsible for this probably has ties to Team Meteor.
ja: これに関わった者は、おそらくチームメテオとつながりがあるでしょう。

key: Those records should be at the Grand Hall.
en: Those records should be at the Grand Hall.
ja: その記録は大ホールにあるはずです。

key: VICTORIA: I'll take care of searching those, and I'll inform the other staff there about what's happened.
en: VICTORIA: I'll take care of searching those, and I'll inform the other staff there about what's happened.
ja: ヴィクトリア: そちらの捜索は私が引き受けます。そこの他のスタッフにも、何があったか伝えておきますね。

key: ADRIENN: Then I'll get Arclight into medical care, and organize a party to search Devon and this building.
en: ADRIENN: Then I'll get Arclight into medical care, and organize a party to search Devon and this building.
ja: アドリエンヌ: では私はアークライトを治療に連れて行き、デボンとこの建物を捜索する班を編成します。

key: The fact that they led us here and then set us free probably means they don't intend to use it anymore.
en: The fact that they led us here and then set us free probably means they don't intend to use it anymore.
ja: 私たちをここへ誘い込んでから解放したということは、おそらくもう使うつもりがないということでしょう。

key: So there may be something we can still learn.
en: So there may be something we can still learn.
ja: だから、まだ何か手がかりが得られるかもしれません。

key: \PN, would you come by my Gym a little bit later?
en: \PN, would you come by my Gym a little bit later?
ja: \PN、後ほど私のジムに来てもらえますか?

key: I have one or two requests for you.
en: I have one or two requests for you.
ja: 一つか二つ、頼みたいことがあるんです。

key: VICTORIA: I'll be in touch as well.
en: VICTORIA: I'll be in touch as well.
ja: ヴィクトリア: 私からも連絡しますね。

key: ADRIENN: Good luck.
en: ADRIENN: Good luck.
ja: アドリエンヌ: 幸運を。

key: Everyone is in a fuss about this city restoration business, but isn't all there is to do menial labor work?
en: Everyone is in a fuss about this city restoration business, but isn't all there is to do menial labor work?
ja: みんな街の復興事業だって騒いでるけど、結局やることって単純労働ばっかりじゃないの?

key: If there were something equal to my intellectual abilities, I would surely pitch in.
en: If there were something equal to my intellectual abilities, I would surely pitch in.
ja: 私の知的能力に見合うものがあれば、喜んで力を貸すのだけれど。

key: So, the Leader is asking for help at the Coral Gym?
en: So, the Leader is asking for help at the Coral Gym?
